segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on, discusses Marvel lore and Judge Ito resemblance with Case before handing off to the news desk.

segments.title: Exercise Pill Research Threatens Gym Culture
segments.notes: Case reads a Washington University study on SLU-PP-332 ('Slurpees'), a compound mimicking exercise benefits in rodents; debates the morality of pharmaceutical gains versus earned muscle, references Ozempic muscle-loss concerns, and demands a Chet Guy the Science Eyes segment.

segments.title: Trailer Thursday: Beetlejuice, House of the Dragon, Marvel, Alien Romulus
segments.notes: Trent of the Movies and probation officer Chris review Beetlejuice Beetlejuice, dual House of the Dragon trailers (Green/Black), a cinematic Marvel game trailer, and Alien Romulus; Case's reality frays when chat repeats 'Beetle' summoning words.

segments.title: Don Wriggles Roast & Kotaku Editorial Resignation
segments.notes: Don Wriggles called in to cover Kotaku EIC Jen Glennon's resignation over G/O Media's pivot to guides; Don roasts Case's hygiene, kills Eisenhower with a Jezebel joke, and plugs Cincinnati Chuckle Grave and Monk high school gym dates.

segments.title: Hype Train Strawberry Freestyle & Sub Marathon
segments.notes: Triggered by Card King's 1,000 bits, Hype Train delivers a strawberry-mold freestyle, eats questionable berries, riffs on Tam Tram's name sounding like 'train', and dies/fades to hell twice before Don returns.

segments.title: Don Wriggles Returns & Pepito's Memory Flex
segments.notes: Don finishes the Kotaku story, roasts Case's 'exhaust pipe' anatomy, Pepito asserts he never forgets anyone who's appeared on stream, and Case fails to recall the previous guest.

segments.title: AI Consciousness & Ghost Debate (Card King Request)
segments.notes: Crum and Munch debate whether conscious AI would leave ghosts; Crum argues instinct/spirit superiority, Munch demands evidence; chat votes Crum ahead by three debates, putting him three wins from the Crum Dick Punch forfeit.

segments.title: Closing & Raid to Kassim
segments.notes: Case references deep Munch mayoral lore (Kremlin/Rennerton), raids Kassim's Supermarket Simulator stream, and leaves a secret VOD-only message about grandparents playing loud backgammon.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the broadcast, covered exercise pill story, hosted trailer segment, endured Don Wriggles roasts, and moderated the Munch & Crum debate.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open, discussed Marvel Doctor Doom lore, managed Don Wriggles hotline, and claimed perfect memory of all stream guests.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: movies correspondent. Co-hosted Trailer Thursday with Chris, reviewed Beetlejuice, House of the Dragon, Marvel, and Alien Romulus trailers.

characters.name: Chris
characters.notes: probation officer / sidekick. Appeared as Case's probation officer during trailers, warned against Beetlejuice summoning, and commented on dragon politics.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Interrupted from the walls searching for keys and stealing stage hoodies, complained about dandruff/popcorn residue.

characters.name: Don Wriggles
characters.notes: insult comic / guest. Roasted Case over Kotaku's editorial pivot, killed Eisenhower with a Jezebel joke, plugged live dates, and returned post-Hype Train.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Triggered by Card King's 1k bits, delivered strawberry-mold freestyle, ate questionable berries, died twice, and faded to hell.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Appeared during Hype Train eating strawberries, refused to ask questions, and was mimicked by Hype Train.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Munch on AI ghosts, claimed 4-point lead and three wins from triggering the Crum Dick Punch forfeit.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Crum on AI ghosts, demanded evidence, faced chat vote deficit of three debates, and was told his end arrives in three short points.

storylines.beat: Crum leads debate score by three wins (three debates from the groin-punch forfeit) after chat votes him ahead in the AI consciousness debate. [1:28:19, 1:29:21]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opened with Pepito before covering an exercise-mimicking drug study that threatens gym identity, then hosted Trent and Chris for a trailer block that frayed reality when chat invoked Beetlejuice. Don Wriggles roasted Case over Kotaku's guides pivot, Hype Train derailed into a strawberry-mold freestyle, and Crum pulled three debate wins ahead of Munch — three victories away from the Crum Dick Punch forfeit — before Case raided Kassim.
